scenario_hint: Nexus Station-14 (void_level 1, routine assignment), team assigned 'boring' duties: security audit (rounds 1-4), inventory reconciliation (rounds 5-7), witness interviews for minor theft (rounds 8-10). Subtle wrongness escalates: inventory discrepancies (ritual components missing), witnesses have memory gaps, security logs corrupted, void scanner shows background void rising (1 → 2 → 3), NPCs exhibiting strange behavior (repeating phrases, synchronized movements), environmental atmosphere shifts (lights flickering, temperature drops). Round 11-12: revelation that station's gestator pods have been infiltrated by void cultist sabotage, mass dissolution ritual in progress. Round 13+: explosive crisis - cultists activate ritual, void breach, reality fracture, must prevent mass casualty disaster. Early choices matter: characters who investigated anomalies have clues, those who dismissed them are unprepared.
